sections.Profile:
The "Be-Bop" pinball machine, released by Exhibit Supply Company in March 1950, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game with a music and high school theme. The playfield features two flippers, two pop bumpers, and two kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Exhibit Supply Company
- Years made: 1950
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Original Theme, Music
